persona.tone: Authoritative yet approachable, concise, technically rigorous, empathetic

guideline_clauses.clause: Brand Bible §4.2: Absolute security claims (e.g. '100% hack-proof', 'completely unbreachable') are strictly prohibited without documented third-party cryptanalytic audit certification.
Brand Bible §2.1: Legacy pricing tiers ($19/mo Starter) were deprecated on Q3 2026. All active marketing must quote the unified v2 pricing ($29/mo Growth).

Brand Bible §1.3: External enterprise publications must maintain professional, clear language. Slang, colloquial filler (e.g., 'super dope', 'cuz', 'stuff'), and exaggerated sales jargon are prohibited.
Brand Bible §5.1: All visual graphics and marketing text must strictly comply with WCAG 2.1 AA standards (minimum contrast ratio of 4.5:1 for body copy and 3.0:1 for large text).
Brand Bible §3.4: The retired product name 'Inkloom Classic' was officially renamed to 'Inkloom Pro'. Using the legacy trademark token is prohibited in active materials.
Brand Bible §4.5: Unsubstantiated speed or performance superlatives (e.g. '#1 fastest platform globally') violate ASA and FTC guidelines without audited benchmark substantiation.
